title: A Switching Mechanism for Selecting Environment-Adaptive Personalized Gains in Hearing Aids
abstract: arXiv:2611.27726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized amplification gains for hearing aids have been shown to be preferred over prescriptive gains. Since the preferred settings can vary depending on the background audio environment, this paper presents a switching mechanism or system that automatically selects personalized gains for a current background audio environment. To prevent foreground speech from interfering with background environment analysis, a one-class voice activity detector is designed to identify speech activity from speech mixed with noise. A consistency check is conducted to enable distinguishing foreground speech from background speech, preserving babble as a background environment of interest because hearing aid users often struggle to understand speech in background babble. Sound segments without foreground speech are then analyzed by an online discovery method combining Bayesian change-point detection with a memory of previously encountered environments.

translated_title: 助听器中选择环境自适应个性化增益的切换机制
translated_abstract: 个性化助听器放大增益已被证明比处方式增益更受用户青睐。由于用户偏好设置可能因背景音频环境而异，本文提出了一种切换机制或系统，可根据当前的背景音频环境自动选择个性化增益。为防止前景语音干扰背景环境分析，设计了一种单类语音活动检测器，用于从混合噪声的语音中识别语音活动。通过一致性检查来区分前景语音和背景语音，并将嘈杂人声保留为感兴趣的背景环境，因为助听器用户常常难以在背景嘈杂声中理解语音。随后，通过一种结合贝叶斯变点检测与先前遇到环境记忆的在线发现方法，对不含前景语音的声音片段进行分析。
tldr: 本文提出了一种助听器切换机制，通过单类语音活动检测器排除前景语音干扰，并结合贝叶斯变点检测与历史环境记忆，自动识别当前背景音频环境并选择个性化增益。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a switching mechanism for hearing aids that automatically selects personalized gains adapted to the current background audio environment, using a one-class voice activity detector to exclude foreground speech and Bayesian change-point detection with memory of previously encountered environments.
